text:
Assumption Parish man faces 171 counts of violating protective order
M. S. Hollis
Trey Allen Duet, 27, of Pierre Part, Louisiana, was arrested on Aug. 10 in connection with felony charges stemming from a domestic incident in Pierre Part that resulted in a protective order being filed against him, according to the Assumption Parish Sheriff's Office.
Sheriff Leland Falcon said Duet was personally served the protective order after the incident. During a follow-up investigation, deputies determined that Duet had attempted to or made contact with the victim 171 times in violation of the court-issued protective order.
Duet was charged Tuesday evening with 171 counts of violating protective orders. He remains incarcerated with bond set at $35,000 related to the original domestic charges and is awaiting a bond hearing regarding the new violations.
In addition to these charges, Duet also faces a probation or parole detainer and has been ordered held without bond on that detainer.
For more information concerning this case or news release, Sheriff Falcon advised contacting either himself or Public Information Officer Lonny Cavalier at (985) 498-9353 or (985) 369-2912.
